sets.title: Puzzle 1: choose 4 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A firm picks a team for a client project from these employees: Arun, Bhavna, Charan, Deepa, Eshwar, Farida, Gokul. Exactly 4 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. If Eshwar is selected, Charan must also be selected.
2. Farida and Arun are either both selected or both left out.
3. Eshwar and Gokul are either both selected or both left out.
4. Exactly one of Eshwar, Arun and Farida is selected.
5. At least one of Arun and Bhavna is selected.

sets.title: Puzzle 2: choose 4 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A school chooses a quiz team from these students: Hari, Indira, Jayant, Kavya, Lokesh, Meena, Naveen. Exactly 4 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. Hari is selected only if neither Indira nor Kavya is selected.
2. Lokesh is selected only if neither Meena nor Naveen is selected.
3. If Kavya is not selected, then Meena cannot be selected either.
4. Jayant and Naveen are either both selected or both left out.
5. If Meena is not selected, then Jayant cannot be selected either.

sets.title: Puzzle 3: choose 4 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A panel of experts is formed from these candidates: Omkar, Padma, Qadir, Rekha, Suresh, Tara, Uday. Exactly 4 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. Qadir is selected only if neither Rekha nor Omkar is selected.
2. Qadir and Omkar are either both selected or both left out.
3. Exactly one of Uday, Qadir and Padma is selected.
4. If Suresh is selected, Uday must also be selected.

sets.title: Puzzle 4: choose 3 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A cricket academy selects players for a tour from these trainees: Vikram, Waheeda, Yash, Zoya, Anjali, Balaji, Chitra. Exactly 3 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. Exactly one of Balaji, Chitra and Anjali is selected.
2. At least one of Zoya and Chitra is selected.
3. Yash and Anjali cannot both be selected.
4. Exactly one of Yash and Chitra is selected.
5. Vikram and Balaji are either both selected or both left out.

sets.title: Puzzle 5: choose 4 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A company sends delegates to a conference from these managers: Dinesh, Esther, Firoz, Geeta, Harsh, Isha, Jagan. Exactly 4 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. Isha is selected only if neither Jagan nor Firoz is selected.
2. If Firoz is not selected, then Geeta cannot be selected either.
3. Exactly one of Harsh and Firoz is selected.
4. Exactly one of Esther, Isha and Firoz is selected.
5. If Firoz is selected, Harsh must also be selected.

sets.title: Puzzle 6: choose 4 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A hospital forms an audit committee from these doctors: Karthik, Lata, Mohan, Nisha, Pranav, Revathi, Sanjay. Exactly 4 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. Exactly one of Sanjay, Lata and Revathi is selected.
2. At least one of Sanjay and Karthik is selected.
3. If Mohan is selected, then at least one of Sanjay and Pranav is selected.

sets.title: Puzzle 7: choose 4 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A village council picks volunteers for a festival from these residents: Tejas, Usha, Varun, Yamini, Zubin, Aditi, Bharat. Exactly 4 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. Exactly one of Aditi and Varun is selected.
2. If Yamini is not selected, then Varun cannot be selected either.
3. Exactly one of Tejas, Usha and Bharat is selected.

sets.title: Puzzle 8: choose 3 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A bank shortlists officers for a training programme from these officers: Chetan, Dhanya, Elango, Fatima, Girish, Heena, Imran. Exactly 3 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. Imran and Girish are either both selected or both left out.
2. Girish and Chetan are either both selected or both left out.
3. At least one of Heena and Fatima is selected.

sets.title: Puzzle 9: choose 4 of 7 with conditions
sets.text:
A college forms a cultural committee from these students: Jeeva, Kalpana, Lalit, Mythili, Nikhil, Oviya, Prakash. Exactly 4 of them are to be selected. Conditions:
1. Exactly one of Mythili, Oviya and Lalit is selected.
2. If Mythili is selected, Prakash must also be selected.
3. At least one of Prakash and Kalpana is selected.
4. If Jeeva is selected, then at least one of Nikhil and Lalit is selected.
